CA.rationale: No explicit attention/attention-allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates and color attributes are listed for p0/current/n0, their presentation is specified, and an origin/status field is provided for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to the identified content's organization/access is stated; 'candidate' and processing labels are present but not an attention/allocation relation.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit content values (coordinate sets) with color attributes for specific referents and times.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata are provided separately from the coordinate/color content, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

O.rationale: Entries specify how content is organized/presented (coordinate groupings under named current/candidate referents and times).
